# QS-CFW-6160-72 Quality specification - crankshaft blank CFW-6160-72 (4340)

Revision: Rev D  
Plant: P1  
Part: CFW-6160-72

Scope
This quality specification defines acceptance criteria and inspection requirements for crankshaft blank CFW-6160-72 (4340) produced at Plant P1. It applies to forgings delivered as blanks prior to any finish machining or heat-treatment processes. The document establishes mandatory dimensional and material property limits and the actions required for nonconforming product.

Requirements table
| Characteristic | Requirement |
|---|---|
| Material | 4340 (as specified on part drawing CFW-6160-72) |
| Hardness range | 26-31 HRC. |
| Bore diameter tolerance | ±0.09 mm. |
| Maximum forging weight | 26.9 kg. |
| Surface condition | Free of laps, folds, and mill scale detrimental to downstream processing |

Inspection method
- Hardness: Verify hardness on representative sample locations using a calibrated Rockwell hardness tester using method appropriate for HRC scale. Record values and confirm compliance to the hardness range of 26-31 HRC.
- Bore diameter: Measure bore diameter using calibrated bore gauge or plug gauge. Report measured value and tolerance relative to nominal; confirm compliance to the bore diameter tolerance of ±0.09 mm.
- Weight: Weigh each forging on calibrated scale and confirm weight does not exceed the maximum forging weight of 26.9 kg.
- Surface condition: Visual and tactile inspection under adequate lighting to identify laps, folds, or scale. Parts with suspect internal defects shall be submitted for further evaluation per shop NDE procedure.

Nonconformance handling
- Any part failing to meet the listed requirements shall be segregated, tagged, and logged into the nonconformance register with description of deficiency and reference to this document.
- Disposition options include rework if corrective action will restore conformance without altering part intent, or scrap. Rework and disposition shall require written approval from Quality Engineering.
- Root cause analysis and corrective action shall be initiated for recurring nonconformances. All dispositions and corrective actions shall be recorded and retained per Plant P1 document retention practice.
